# rockets test program

These are the test program binaries (version 0.1.0), as supplied by Lunar with the challenge in [docs/CHALLENGE.md](../../docs/CHALLENGE.md). There is one build per OS and architecture. They are vendored so the repo is self-contained.

```
vendor/rockets/windows_amd64/rockets.exe launch "http://localhost:8088/messages"
```

On macOS and Linux, run `chmod +x` on the binary first if it isn't executable.
